name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and enables Nginx, configures three named sites with static content and virtual hosts, and applies TLS, firewall, SSH, Fail2ban, and sysctl security settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, post-install configuration, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, a virtual environment, application dependencies, database credentials, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
